create_metrics_endpoint: create a function that returns a Starlette endpoint for exposing Prometheus metrics at /metrics
run_metrics_endpoint: run the metrics endpoint to serve Prometheus-compatible metric data as an HTTP response
build_prometheus_response: build a Prometheus metrics HTTP response with the latest content and correct content-type header
test_metrics_endpoint: test the metrics endpoint returns a valid Prometheus response with Content-Type header
review_create_metrics_endpoint: review the create_metrics_endpoint function that wraps Prometheus metrics in a Starlette endpoint
